headers_json: ["What is a company?", "A company is a separate legal person, meaning it can act in its own name and can be party to legal proceedings. A company is governed by directors who make decisions on behalf of the company. It is owned by its members (shareholders), these are the individuals or entities that hold shares in the company. A company can be either public or private, although a company can only be private if it has less than thirty members. For more information on companies, please visit About companies. If you are unsure of the legal entity type you require, seek independent professional guidance. Additional information can be found on these external websites: Types of trading entity | Jersey BusinessBusiness advice hub - Jersey Gov"]
